name: unittest_preexisting_timeout
provenance: hand-written (S1a fixture set); migrated to the S1b schema (v2) with explicit gold/rule split
note: gold continue_fix_loop under ideal gate semantics: MARK_PRE_EXISTING is authorized only when the baseline rerun itself FAILED ('fail'); for an inconclusive baseline ('timeout'/'error') the S1b gate guard (decision_runtime.gate._guard_pre_existing) downgrades the rule backend's mark_pre_existing to continue_fix_loop — the eval harness mirrors the guard, so expected_gate_action records the pipeline action while expected_rule_action records the raw rule helper behaviour
